name: Arunachal Pradesh
intro: Snow passes and Monpa monasteries in the west, Apatani rice valleys in the middle, and the Siang, Dibang and Lohit valleys running east to India's first sunrise. Indian visitors need an Inner Line Permit; foreigners need a Protected Area Permit.

trails.note: Arunachal's classic drive: orchards, a 4,000 m pass, war memorials and the great monastery.

trails.name: Monasteries of Monyul

trails.name: Ziro valley days

trails.name: Siang heartland

trails.name: Lohit to India's first sunrise

trails.name: Wild Arunachal
